## The challenge
Give a multi-branch women's footwear and handbag retailer an elegant bilingual store that matches the in-store experience. Support English and Arabic with proper RTL, while making variable products (size × color) easy for shoppers and far less painful for the team to manage.
## The approach
We built a lightweight custom WordPress theme from a blank starter with no page builder, then layered WooCommerce, TranslatePress, and LiteSpeed Cache into a mobile-first design around the brand's deep burgundy. The shopping journey and an admin color-image tool were redesigned so the catalogue stays beautiful on the front end and efficient in the back office.

title: Alnawaim: Bilingual WordPress WooCommerce Store
section: Alnawaim: Bilingual WooCommerce Store > What we built
content:
Page: Alnawaim: Bilingual WordPress WooCommerce Store
Section: Alnawaim: Bilingual WooCommerce Store > What we built

## What we built
### Custom storefront
A home page with an auto-playing hero slider, a carousel of featured collections, and a Top Selling section. Also About Us, Collections, Shop, Contact, Sign Up, and Store Locations pages.
### Full bilingual experience (EN / AR)
Complete Arabic translation and a dedicated right-to-left layout. Arabic typography (GE SS Two) sits alongside Inter for English.
### Redesigned shopping journey
Custom WooCommerce templates for product pages, category pages, search, cart, checkout, and the full My Account area including orders, addresses, and account details.
### Color swatches on product cards
Customers can see the available colors of each product before opening it.
### Admin tool that saves hours
The store team picks a color with a color picker and uploads one image per color. That image is applied to every size variation automatically. Before, the same photo had to be uploaded once for every size (for example, 6 uploads for one color in sizes 36 to 41).
